did: I built the way home's own dashboards reach the public site, after you said yes on #3415. Home photographs file_host's dashboard and the CPU panel once a week, on its own Grafana, as a short silent clip and a still. It puts them in the Jobs mailbox, and the site's build fetches them with a key that can only read pictures. Home holds no GitHub token. The mailbox side is merged and deployed, the walk and the site's fetch are merged, and home's side is armed to merge. I also bumped a dependency on the server for a security advisory that was failing every server PR.

calls.title: How pictures taken on home reach the site's build
options: Through the Jobs mailbox, read by a key that can only read pictures
Home starts a GitHub workflow with an Actions token
Home uploads a release asset or commits the pictures
calls.why: A GitHub artifact can only be made inside a workflow run, and nothing on GitHub can reach home. Home already talks to the mailbox, so this needs no GitHub token on home, and each other option needs a broader token or runs outside code on home (C1071).
calls.undo: Remove the mailbox's site-assets folder and pages role, and Site Assets' home job; both cards go back to their drawings.

calls.title: The dashboard pictures are walks through home's Grafana, not a recorder of their own
options: A new Grafana stage in the existing walk and walkthrough pipeline
A separate recorder that screenshots panels and joins them
Grafana's own image renderer, as another service on home
calls.why: The APK and extension clips already go through walks, so this is one more stage rather than a second pipeline, and home keeps one batch worker (C1073).
calls.undo: Remove the home-server and home-cores walks and the grafana stage.

calls.title: Home photographs one week at a time, and gives up on a week it cannot show whole
options: Each week, asked within a day of its end, dropped once Prometheus no longer holds all of it
Whenever the site's build asks for new pictures
calls.why: Prometheus on home keeps 200 hours, only 32 past a week's end, so a later picture would draw part of the week as all of it. A weekly request is a time that has passed; the render lane still decides when it runs (C1074).
calls.undo: Change ASK_WITHIN and DRAWN_WITHIN in file_host's site_shots, or raise Prometheus's retention, which is your call.

calls.title: A picture is held to 768 KiB in the mailbox, below its usual 1 MiB
calls.why: Reading back a body near 1 MiB from D1 may not fit the Worker's 10 ms of CPU, and the silent clip came to about 756 KB at full size anyway (C1072).
calls.undo: Set the picture cap back to the folder-wide 1 MiB in apps/mailbox's core.ts.

left: The CPU cost of reading a near-cap clip from the mailbox is not measured yet: it waits on the pages key in #3423.
Home's side photographs nothing until server#1120 merges, the release PR pins a render image that has the walks, and you run make home-deploy.
The phone's Renders board names the new job only by its kind, Site shots; its own words are a later story.
